title: Aurevant Font
author: Retro
description:
AUREVANT – Bold Luxury Serif Display Font | OTF Font
Introducing AUREVANT, a sophisticated serif display typeface designed to bring timeless elegance, confidence, and a premium editorial feel to your creative projects.
Featuring bold uppercase letterforms, high-contrast strokes, distinctive serif details, and a refined fashion-inspired appearance, AUREVANT is perfect for designers seeking a striking yet elegant typographic style.
From luxury brand identities to fashion campaigns and premium packaging, AUREVANT helps transform ordinary designs into memorable visual experiences.
Perfect For
Luxury logos and brand identities
Fashion and editorial design
Perfume and fragrance packaging
Beauty and skincare branding
Jewelry and boutique logos
Magazine covers and headlines
Premium product packaging
Wedding invitations and stationery
Posters and advertising campaigns
Business cards and promotional materials
Social media graphics
Elegant merchandise and lifestyle branding
Font Features
Bold serif display style
High-contrast strokes
Elegant, fashion-inspired letterforms
Strong visual presence for headlines
Ideal for luxury and editorial projects
Suitable for print and digital designs
File Information
File Type: OTF Only
Format: OpenType Font (.otf)
Font Style: Bold Serif Display
Product Type: Digital font download
Important Information
This listing includes the OTF font file only. No physical product will be shipped. Preview images and promotional mockups are for presentation purposes and are not included unless explicitly stated.
Please review the font’s character support and applicable license terms before purchasing, especially for commercial projects.
Make a lasting impression with AUREVANT — bold elegance for distinctive brands.
